title: Schedule of Apparel Reductions on Deposit Pre-Order Replacement Deposits — Pre-Orders & Back-Orders
content:
The customer's apparel purchase count takes percentage points off the replacement deposit percentage of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order replacement. The count is the number of apparel lines booked on the customer's Marlowe & Finch orders, the Online Orders on the profile. The window they are counted over depends on the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership.

| Apparel lines counted | Percentage points off |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 |
| 3 up to fewer than 6 | 1 |
| Fewer than 3 | 0 |

The points come off the replacement deposit percentage after every multiplication of that percentage and before the percentage is applied to the price.

**Band edges**

| Count | Points off |
|---|---|
| 2 | 0 |
| 3 | 1 |
| 5.5 | 1 |
| 6 | 2 |

A count that is not a whole number is placed in the band its value falls in.

**Example (hypothetical).** A replacement deposit percentage standing at 18, for a customer with 7 apparel lines counted, becomes 16 before it is applied to the price.
